about: A photo with a message, and a person's family documents (lib/attachments.mjs), configuration and never code. photo.model is the vision model that describes a photo; the band's model answers from the description. One photo a turn. maxBytes is the photo once decoded. The daily limit counts photos sent to the vision model, per family, by the family's own date; the synthetic sample family shares one small limit. These are cost guards for the founding test, set by hand before the cost of a photo was known. documents: how many a person may have and how much text in all; they are sent with every turn, so the limit is also a cost guard. This file is inside the image, so a change here is a release.
